verdict.rationale: Rive's homepage says an agent can generate experiences "with the CLI", and RML lets Rive files be built as text outside the Editor. Both point to non-GUI automation, but there is only a single thin CLI mention and no documentation of headless or CI operation. The MCP integration attaches to the running Editor, so it is not headless. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and usage, explicit headless/CI execution guidance (e.g. building or exporting .riv files without the Editor), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: let an agent generate them with the CLI
making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor
